Passionate about cutting-edge engineering, business development, and sustainability? Want to help one of Denmark’s leading greentech companies expand its global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you!

Our Business Development team is looking for a Student Assistant to support our growth and help make our sales workflows more structured, efficient, and intelligent. This role is for someone who enjoys technical sales, organising information, improving processes, and figuring out how AI can solve real business problems.

About the job

You will join the Business Development team and work on projects across technical proposals, admin, contract management, and AI implementations.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Organising and optimising business development workflows, documentation, and proposals

• Helping the team with technical presentations and client engagement

• Supporting the team with vendor system registrations and other digital client platforms

• Building and implementing AI-powered automations to improve sales efficiency and business intelligence flows

• Supporting data structures, updating internal statistics, templates, and internal resources

About you

• Currently pursuing a master’s degree in engineering (environment or sustainability), industrial engineering and management, business analysis, business administration, data technology, or a related field

• Passionate about tech, with an interest in AI and new digital tools

• Diligent and organised, with an interest in improving workflows and processes

• Proactive and practical, with the ability to take ownership and turn ideas into solutions

• Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other relevant software is a plus but not a requirement

• Fluency in English; Danish is not a requirement

What we offer

• Hands-on experience implementing AI automations in a real business environment

• A flat hierarchy where initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early

• Flexible working hours suited to balance work and study

• Free lunch, snacks, and coffee, with occasional team events and Friday bars

• A close-knit, international and supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning

About Explicit

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish engineering company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, resource, and other industry sectors. We deliver reliable, transparent, and actionable emissions data to some of the world’s largest energy companies using our patented drone-based methodology.

We are headquartered in Virum, Denmark, with offices in Norway, Germany and Australia and survey operations across six continents. Our international team of 30+ colleagues brings together engineering, data and environmental expertise, united by a shared mission to make a difference in emissions monitoring.

Practical information

• Working hours: Minimum 15 hours per week, with flexibility around your studies and exam periods

• Application deadline: 30 October 2026

• Expected start date: November 2026

• Location: Virum, Denmark

How to apply

Please send your application and your CV to jobs@explicit.dk.

If you have any questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Luca Ledermann, Business Development Director, at lle@explicit.dk.

Field-ready emissions monitoring and analytics

Our emissions monitoring technology and expertise are accredited, reliable solutions, tailored to your industry and business needs.

We offer fully managed services covering field operations, data processing, and reporting, as well as collaborative models where we support local partners with training, sensor payloads, data analysis, and quality control.

Get in touch with the E-team

As Area Sales Manager, you will be central to Sievi’s transition from an agent-based model to a dedicated sales organisation in Denmark. Reporting directly to the International Sales Manager, you will take responsibility for developing the Danish market by strengthening relationships with distributors, industrial companies, and end-users.

This is a role with high visibility and responsibility, where your consultative approach and proactive market presence will help shape Sievi’s future growth in Denmark.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Drive sales and achieve budget targets through both account management and new business development.

• Maintain a strong market presence through regular customer visits and stakeholder engagement.

• Build close relationships with end-user stakeholders such as safety managers, union representatives, and company buyers.

• Collaborate closely with the Sales Director and International Sales to handle larger national accounts.

• Act as a trusted advisor by translating Sievi’s product features (standards, durability, comfort, sustainability) into customer value.

The Candidate Profile

• Proven B2B sales experience from technical products, PPE, industrial products, construction, tools or related sectors.

• Strong relationship builder with a consultative approach, not transactional.

• Proactive, structured, and self-sufficient - thrives in independent field work.

• Fluent in spoken and written Danish, with good English for Nordic collaboration.

• Comfortable with CRM systems and digital tools for sales management.

• Commercial, technical or vocational education, combined with a strong customer-oriented mindset.

Why Join Sievi?

• Join a well-consolidated, profitable Nordic company with a strong brand and reputation for quality.

• Be part of Sievi’s strategic shift in Denmark, moving from agents to a dedicated sales organization.

• Work in a market with real momentum: ongoing consolidation and shifts in the competitive landscape create clear opportunities to win new business.

• Take on a role with high visibility and responsibility, reporting directly to the International Sales Manager.

• Competitive compensation package including base salary, performance bonus, company car, pension, and benefits.

• This is a unique opportunity to join at an exciting stage. You will play a key role in establishing and expanding Sievi’s direct market presence in Denmark and have a genuine impact on the company’s future success.

Location

We are looking for an Area Sales Manager to cover Jutland and parts of Funen, with a particular focus on the Triangle Region (Vejle, Kolding and Middelfart).

Home-office based with frequent travel to customer sites.

How To Apply

Please send your CV and application as soon as possible, we process applications continuously. For further information, you are welcome to contact Susanne Jansen, Mercuri Urval, +45 6071 6044.

All inquiries are handled confidentially.

Non-Key Expert – Private Sector Engagement

NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project “Support to the Africa-EU Space Partnership Programme – AESPP Boost.”

The programme aims to strengthen cooperation between Africa and the European Union in the space sector, supporting policy dialogue, institutional partnerships, knowledge exchange, innovation, private sector engagement and investment, while contributing to stronger and more sustainable African space ecosystems.

In this context, we are seeking a highly qualified Non-Key Expert – Private Sector Engagement Expert to support activities aimed at strengthening private sector participation, business development, innovation, investment and commercial opportunities within the African and European space ecosystems.

Minimum Qualifications and Skills

• University degree at Master’s level in economics, business administration, engineering, innovation management, or a related field. In the absence of such degree, four additional years of relevant professional experience.

• Excellent command of English.

• Working knowledge of French and/or Portuguese will be considered an asset.

Minimum General Professional Experience

• Minimum 8 years of professional experience in private sector development, industrial cooperation, innovation, business development and/or investment facilitation.

Minimum Specific Professional Experience

• At least 4 years of professional experience engaging companies, entrepreneurs and/or investors, including market/value-chain analysis, business support, matchmaking, commercialisation and/or access to finance.

• Experience in the space, geospatial or technology sector and in Africa is highly relevant..

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply and upload your CV via LinkedIn or send to recruitment@ntu.eu. Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted due to the large amount of applicants

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Project Manager to join our New Product Introduction (NPI) team.

As Project Manager in NPI you will work closely together with optical, electrical, mechanical and software engineers on maturing design and developing assembly and test processes. When the project has proven the product can be manufactured with satisfactory yield, it will be transferred to Operations, freeing up space and resources for the new next project.

**What You Will Do

**

• Lead maturation and transfer projects of laser products.

• Be responsible for planning resource alignment, risk and change management, project reporting, and follow-up the gate process to ensure projects are delivered within scope, on time, and within budget.

**What You Bring

**To succeed in this role, you should have a technical background in one or more of the following areas: optics/photonics, electronics, or production engineering.

**Essential

**

• Demonstrated experience delivering complex technical projects, ideally related to product development, product maturation, or technology transfer.

• Ability to effectively lead technical specialists and facilitate project meetings, design reviews, and key decision-making processes.

• Experience working in a manufacturing environment.

• Communicate fluently in English and thrive in cross-functional, international teams.

**What We Offer

**We want you to feel supported, both at work and outside it. Our benefits include:

• A 12% employer-paid pension contribution and health insurance.

• An annual bonus programme.

• 25 days of paid vacation, plus five additional days once you have been with us for nine months.

• Access to thousands of courses through LinkedIn Learning.

• Wellbeing initiatives and an annual flu vaccination.

• Freshly prepared meals from our subsidised on-site canteen.

• Free parking at our Birkerød site.

• Social activities through our Employee Association.

_Benefits are subject to eligibility and the relevant plan or policy terms.

_**Practical Information

**

• Working arrangement: On site

• Working language: English

• Employment: Full time

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

**Job Description

**The Sales Manager & Strategic Account Lead is a pivotal leadership role combining people leadership, commercial execution, strategic account management, and customer engagement.

This role is responsible for building and developing a high-performing field team and for strengthening engagement across general practice, hospitals, pharmacies, and other relevant healthcare stakeholders and partners.

In parallel, the role serves as a strategic lead for Primary Care business and partnerships, with responsibility for improving patient care pathways through high-level stakeholder engagement, developing innovative partnerships, and driving customer segmentation and targeting excellence to optimize commercial execution and customer engagement.

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial capabilities with an entrepreneurial mindset, a passion for developing people, and the ability to translate strategy and customer insights into impactful execution.

**Key Responsibilities

**Sales Team Leadership

• Build, lead, coach, and inspire a high-performing field team to achieve commercial objectives across hospital, general practice, pharmacy channels, and strategic partnerships.

• Set clear priorities, performance expectations, and development goals to support individual and team success.

• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, innovation, and compliance.

Strategy Development and Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with the Business Unit Lead, Marketing, and other cross-functional colleagues to shape commercial strategies and co-create solutions.

• Ensure that field execution and account management support overarching business and brand objectives.

• Act as a strategic bridge between field execution, Marketing, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Business Intelligence, Analytics, and other relevant functions.

Customer Segmentation & Targeting Excellence

• Lead the development, implementation, and continuous optimization of customer segmentation and targeting models.

• Ensure segmentation insights drive customer engagement strategies, account prioritization, resource allocation, omnichannel execution, and field force effectiveness.

• Translate customer, market, and behavioral data into actionable engagement frameworks.

Strategic Primary Care Engagement

• Strengthen engagement within Primary Care by building strategic relationships with key healthcare stakeholders and decision-makers.

• Identify opportunities to optimize and improve patient care pathways.

• Represent the organization in relevant healthcare forums and stakeholder engagements.

Partnership & Business Development

• Provide strategic direction and leadership in developing innovative commercial partnerships and new ways of engaging healthcare and non-traditional stakeholders.

• Identify and assess new opportunities and collaboration models that can improve customer engagement, patient pathways, and access to appropriate healthcare interventions.

• Support the development of scalable business cases and commercial models, including implementation coaching.

**Primary Tasks

**Sales & People Management

• Build and develop a strong field organization.

• Coach and develop team members to enable both individual and team success.

• Analyze territory data, customer engagement metrics, and market dynamics to optimize resource allocation, targeting, and commercial performance.

• Continuously refine customer segmentation and targeting models to optimize call planning, account prioritization, and customer engagement.

Strategic Commercial Alignment

• Collaborate with Marketing and cross-functional partners to provide field-based insights that shape go-to-market strategies.

• Drive adoption of segmentation-driven and omnichannel engagement approaches across the field organization.

• Ensure field execution remains closely aligned with business priorities.

Strategic Account Management

• Identify, map, prioritize, and engage critical stakeholders influencing Primary Care and patient pathways.

• Build strategic relationships with relevant healthcare decision-makers at local and regional levels.

• Identify friction points and opportunities within patient pathways and collaborate on solutions to improve patient outcomes.

Business Development & Partnerships

• Further develop strategic approaches to partnerships across traditional and non-traditional healthcare stakeholders.

• Prioritize partnership opportunities based on market insights, customer needs, and business potential.

• Support implementation of partnership models and commercial initiatives.

**Qualifications & Competencies

**Education

• Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Life Sciences, Public Health, or a related field.

**Experience

**

• Strong experience from the pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another relevant commercial environment.

• Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into impactful execution.

• Previous people leadership or Sales Manager experience is preferred but not required.

• Experience in Key Account Management, strategic account management, commercial excellence, sales force effectiveness, customer engagement, or similar commercially focused roles is an advantage.

• Experience using customer segmentation, targeting, customer insights, and analytics to improve commercial execution is preferred.

Leadership & People Development

• A people-oriented leader who can inspire, coach, and develop others.

• Ability to lead through collaboration, influence, accountability, and a genuine desire to enable others to succeed.

Market Knowledge

• Strong understanding of the Danish healthcare environment and the interaction between Primary Care, pharmacies, scientific leaders, healthcare decision-makers, and other relevant stakeholders.

Commercial & Strategic Acumen

• Strong strategic and entrepreneurial mindset.

• Ability to translate customer needs, market dynamics, data, and commercial opportunities into clear priorities and effective execution.

Data & Customer Insights

• Strong interest in using data and customer insights to inform decision-making.

• Ability to apply segmentation, targeting, account prioritization, and resource allocation principles effectively.

Communication & Influence

• Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills.

• Ability to build trust, create alignment, and influence colleagues and external stakeholders across functions and organizational levels.

Language

• Native or fluent Danish and professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

**What We Offer

**

• A high-impact leadership role with broad commercial and strategic responsibility.

• The opportunity to shape customer engagement, strategic partnerships, and patient pathway improvements.

• A dynamic, collaborative, and cross-functional working environment.

• Significant opportunity to influence business strategy and execution.

• A role with strong focus on leadership development, innovation, and commercial excellence.

• The chance to work with talented colleagues and external stakeholders to create meaningful impact for patients and healthcare systems.

**Required Skills

**Business Case Development, Business Decisions, Business Development, Business Sales, Key Account Planning, Market Research, Team Coaching

**Preferred Skills

Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind as well as other non-hydro Renewable activities like solar PV and batteries. Today we develop, construct and operate wind generation in Sweden, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK. In addition, we have a clear strategy to develop our solar PV and battery operations further.

Within Business Unit Offshore, Project Execution is responsible for the contracting and execution of our construction projects. Our vision is to stay ahead of the competition by safely constructing next-generation offshore wind farms and leveraging our expertise during the planning and contracting phases to ensure successful project delivery.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Construction Engineer to join our Construction Management team. You will independently lead assigned work scopes and contribute to the safe, technically sound, commercially disciplined and timely delivery of offshore construction activities across planning, procurement, execution, logistics and close-out.

Your Responsibilities:

As Senior Construction Engineer, you will lead assigned Construction Management work scopes supporting the offshore construction and commissioning of an offshore wind farm. Reporting to the Construction Manager, you will manage each scope from initial concept and specification development through procurement, contract implementation, execution and close-out, with accountability for recommendations and deliverables within agreed budget, schedule, quality and HSE requirements.

Typical scopes include:

• Interim maintenance services and offshore maintenance campaigns

• Commissioning Service Operation Vessels (CSOV)

• Crew Transfer Vessels (CTV)

• Guard vessels

• Temporary Aids to Navigation (AtoN)

• Offshore site setup and construction base harbour facilities

• Communication systems and offshore coordination tools

• Marine coordination support services

• Construction management documentation and operational procedures

• Additional construction management scopes as required during project execution

You will:

• Take full ownership of assigned scopes, including technical definition, procurement support, contract implementation, budget control, schedule management and contractor follow-up.

• Develop technical specifications, scopes of work, evaluation criteria and technical recommendations for procurement processes.

• Manage contractors throughout engineering, mobilisation and offshore execution phases and ensure contractual deliverables are achieved.

• Review contractor engineering documentation, procedures, risk assessments, work packs and marine operational documentation to verify compliance, technical quality and readiness for execution.

• Develop and maintain Construction Management procedures and operational documentation, including marine operations procedures, offshore site descriptions, construction work plans and readiness documentation.

• Coordinate interfaces between contractors, package managers, site management, marine coordination, O&M and external stakeholders.

• Support offshore campaign execution by providing technical input to site and offshore management teams and helping resolve operational issues, including simultaneous operations.

• Ensure compliance with project requirements, HSE standards, marine regulations and permit conditions throughout all project phases.

• Capture and implement lessons learned from offshore campaigns and transfer knowledge across the wider Project Execution organisation.

• Establish and manage assigned parts of the Construction Management contract portfolio, including vessel, maintenance, offshore support and site-facility contracts. Take responsibility for scope, cost, schedule, contractor performance and change control.

Location: The position can be based in Kolding (Denmark), Hamburg (Germany) or Amsterdam (Netherlands).

You will work in an international project environment and collaborate regularly with colleagues, contractors and project teams across our offshore locations. The role requires regular travel and periods of work at project, harbour and offshore locations. The frequency and duration will depend on the project phase and assigned work scopes.

Qualifications

Your Profile:

You are an experienced offshore professional who can independently lead complex technical work scopes and work effectively across multidisciplinary and international teams.

The successful candidate will have:

• A relevant engineering degree or equivalent technical qualification, together with fluent written and spoken English. Relevant offshore training and certifications are expected for the assigned work scopes.

• Clear communication, collaborative leadership and sound commercial judgement, with the ability to structure complex work, set priorities, make evidence-based decisions and drive improvement.

• At least eight years of relevant experience in offshore construction, offshore wind, marine operations or comparable offshore industries, including responsibility for complex technical work scopes.

• Demonstrated experience managing technical work scopes from early engineering through procurement, contract implementation and offshore execution.

• Strong understanding of offshore construction interfaces and vessel operations, including foundations, cables, WTGs, CSOVs, CTVs, marine logistics, contractor mobilisation, marine coordination and operational readiness.

• Practical experience coordinating contractors and multiple work scopes in a live offshore construction environment.

• The ability to identify technical, operational and logistical risks at an early stage and proactively implement mitigation measures.

• Strong knowledge of HSE management, risk assessment methodologies, marine regulations and permit conditions, with demonstrated experience applying them during offshore planning and execution.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively with contractors, package teams, site management and O&M organisations.

Additional Information

Our offer

We offer an international and collaborative working environment, attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development. You will work with experienced colleagues across disciplines and be encouraged to ask questions, share knowledge and contribute to continuous improvement.

More Information

Incoming applications are reviewed and evaluated on an ongoing basis. Therefore, this vacancy may be filled before the application deadline. The application deadline is October 25, 2026.

We welcome your application in English and kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Sandra Domschke via email: sandra1.domschke@vattenfall.de

Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 20 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

jobs.description:
At Konica Minolta, we believe great workplaces are built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We are looking for a Nordic Quality Manager who is passionate about creating structure, driving positive change, and helping our Nordic organization operate at high standards of quality, sustainability, and information security.

This is not just a compliance role. It is an opportunity to influence how we work, support leaders and teams across the Nordics, and make a real impact on our customers, employees, and business.

What you'll be doing

As one of our Nordic Quality Managers, you will help to improve our Integrated Management System (IMS), covering Quality, Environment, and Information Security. You will work closely with colleagues across the Nordic countries and be a trusted advisor to the business.

Some of your key responsibilities will include:

• Driving the development and implementation of our IMS strategy across the Nordic region

• Maintaining and improving processes, policies, and tools related to quality management, environmental management, and information security

• Leading internal and external audits within ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 27001

• Supporting governance initiatives and reporting activities

• Delivering engaging training and awareness activities across the organization

• Acting as a trusted advisor and collaborating with external stakeholders, certification bodies, customers, and internal teams across the Nordics

• Traveling to Konica Minolta offices across the Nordics 10-15 days per year

What success looks like

You create clarity where others see complexity.

You build strong partnerships across the business and inspire others to embrace quality and continuous improvement.

You balance attention to detail with a practical business mindset and know how to turn requirements into value for the organization.

What we're looking for

We know that great candidates do not always tick every box. If you are excited about the role, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every requirement.

Ideally, you bring:

• Minimum 5 years of experience working with ISO management systems, preferably ISO 9001, 14001 and/or 27001

• Knowledge of quality management, information security, sustainability, or related disciplines

• Strong communication skills and confidence working with stakeholders at different levels

• A structured and proactive approach

• Experience managing projects or driving organizational improvements

• Professional English skills, written and spoken

Why join Konica Minolta?

At Konica Minolta, you will become part of a supportive Nordic team where collaboration comes naturally and where your contribution truly matters. Working together with another Nordic Quality Manager and reporting to the Nordic Head of Legal & Compliance, you will play a key role in driving quality and continuous improvement across the Nordic organization.

We offer:

• Meaningful work with a clear purpose

• Nordic collaboration and international exposure

• Opportunity to influence strategic initiatives

• Professional and personal development opportunities

• Flexible ways of working

• A culture built on trust, accountability, inclusion, and collaboration

About Konica Minolta as a workplace

At Konica Minolta, we value different perspectives and actively work to create an environment where everyone feels welcome and respected. We believe that diversity in experience, background, and ways of thinking makes us stronger. This employer-branding wording is reflected in the attached recruitment material.

We offer a professional environment with strong collaboration, flexibility in everyday work, and the opportunity to contribute to meaningful digital development across the business. The attached recruitment template also highlights benefits such as pension, health insurance, lunch arrangement, fitness facilities, and social activities.

Practical information

• Location: Copenhagen / Ballerup area, onsite setup

• Employment type: Full-time

• Salary: According to qualifications

• Employment date: 1st of January 2027 or before

How to apply

Please send your application and CV no later than 10 November 2026.

If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to connect with our Head of Nordic Legal & Compliance, Kristian Øhrstrøm at Kristian.Ohrstrom@konicaminolta.dk.

Feel free to submit your application already today – we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right match. We look forward to hearing from you!

About Konica Minolta:

Konica Minolta Business Solutions Denmark a/s is a leading provider of printing solutions for office and production environments. Our portfolio ranges from hardware and print software to automation and data security, and we also deliver solutions within Document Management and Cyber Security.

In Denmark, we have approximately 120 employees and an annual revenue of DKK 260 million, spanning sales, service, and support across IT, print and copy solutions, as well as digital services. Globally, Konica Minolta employs around 40,000 people.

Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Location: Copenhagen, Denmark - On-site

Type: Full-time

Industry: Biotechnology | Biomanufacturing | Synthetic Biology

About the Company

We are working with an innovative Copenhagen-based synthetic biology company developing a genetic platform designed to improve the productivity and stability of production hosts and cell lines used in recombinant biomanufacturing.

The technology links production to cellular fitness, helping cells maintain productivity for longer production runs and at larger scale. The platform has already been demonstrated across 20+ bioproducts, ranging from industrial enzymes and food proteins to pharmaceutical peptides and biologics.

The company is now looking for a Business Development Manager to help grow and qualify its customer pipeline across the international biomanufacturing market.

Why Join?

You will join a growing team of approximately 25 people, where your contribution will be highly visible and your commercial results will directly influence the company's growth.

You will become part of the commercial team and work closely with leadership, scientists and the client delivery team.

The company offers a competitive salary package including bonus, together with the opportunity to bring an innovative and proven technology to biomanufacturing customers.

The Role

As Business Development Manager, you will be responsible for identifying and developing new commercial opportunities across biopharma, CDMOs and bioindustrial companies.

Your role starts with understanding the market: identifying relevant applications, companies and decision-makers. From there, you will initiate conversations, qualify opportunities and understand both the customer's technical needs and commercial potential.

You will lead initial discovery and pitch meetings and work closely with the client delivery team to advance the most promising opportunities. Depending on your experience, you may also take responsibility for scope and commercial discussions.

You won't be starting from zero. An established CRM, market databases, sales tools, active pipeline and existing prospective-partner dialogues are already in place.

What You'll Do

• Extend existing market mapping across applications, target companies and key decision-makers.

• Run outbound prospecting and manage and prioritize inbound opportunities.

• Lead initial discovery and pitch meetings to understand customer needs, technical fit and appropriate next steps.

• Represent the company at relevant conferences, industry events and customer meetings.

• Develop and tailor pitch decks, case studies and other customer-facing materials.

• Coordinate customer proposals together with the client delivery team, including the customer narrative, scope, deliverables and timelines.

• Maintain structured follow-up and accurate CRM management.

• Depending on experience, contribute to or lead commercial and scope discussions with prospective customers.

What You Bring

You have a scientific background in biotechnology, molecular biology, bioprocessing or a related discipline, ideally at MSc or PhD level.

You bring approximately 3–5 years of experience in business development, technical sales or another customer-facing commercial role within biotechnology, biomanufacturing, CDMO services or platform technologies.

You are comfortable discussing science with experienced technical audiences while also understanding the commercial side of a customer opportunity.

Ideally, you have experience with:

• Prospecting and qualifying new customer opportunities.

• Presenting complex technical solutions.

• Developing or contributing to tailored customer proposals.

• Managing customer relationships and commercial follow-up.

• Working systematically with CRM tools and sales pipelines.

• Communicating clearly and professionally in English.

Experience with microbial or CHO production systems, an established biomanufacturing industry network or complex deal negotiations would be an advantage.

The Person

You are self-driven, commercially curious and genuinely interested in understanding the science behind what you sell.

You enjoy opening doors and starting conversations, but you're equally comfortable listening carefully and determining whether there is a genuine technical and commercial fit.

This is particularly important because you will be introducing a relatively new approach to experienced scientific and technical audiences. You'll therefore need the confidence to initiate conversations while having the judgement to know when to bring scientific colleagues into the discussion.

Practical Details

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark – on-site

Travel: International travel for conferences and client visits should be expected

Compensation: Competitive salary package including attractive bonus

Language: Fluent English required; Danish is an advantage

jobs.occupation: Senior Stakeholder Engagement Manager - Hesselø Offshore Wind
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Job Description

Do you want to create lasting value for communities while helping shape Denmark's fossil-free future?

We are looking for an experienced and strategic Senior Stakeholder Engagement Manager to play a leading role in the development of the Hesselø offshore wind project, one of Denmark's most significant future renewable energy projects.

The Hesselø offshore wind project is located in the Kattegat Sea between Denmark and Sweden, approximately 30 kilometres from the coast, with a minimum installed capacity of 800 MW. The project includes both offshore and onshore infrastructure and will make a significant contribution to Denmark's future fossil-free energy production.

As Senior Stakeholder Engagement Manager, you will help ensure that the project is developed in close collaboration with local communities, stakeholders and partners. You will lead stakeholder engagement activities throughout the development process, helping create understanding, trust and meaningful dialogue while supporting the successful delivery of this strategically important infrastructure project.

You will act as one of the project's key representatives and serve as a bridge between the project organisation and external stakeholders, ensuring that local insights, concerns and opportunities are incorporated into decision-making processes.

Working closely with colleagues across Consenting, Communications, Public & Regulatory Affairs, Development, Environmental functions and Project Delivery, you will help shape how Vattenfall engages with communities, authorities and stakeholders throughout the project's lifecycle.

Be in your element with BA Wind

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Qualifications

What will you do?

As Senior Stakeholder Engagement Manager, you will design and implement stakeholder engagement and communication strategies that support project development, permitting and long-term success. This includes mapping and analysing stakeholder interests, developing engagement plans and ensuring that activities meet regulatory requirements while going beyond compliance.

You will build and maintain trusted relationships with communities, municipalities, authorities, NGOs, industry organisations, businesses, landowners and other stakeholders. As a key point of contact, you will facilitate constructive dialogue, capture feedback and ensure that local insights are reflected in project decision-making.

You will also create clear content for project channels and public meetings, provide transparent and timely information, and strengthen local understanding of offshore wind. Working closely with Public & Regulatory Affairs, Communications, Environmental teams and Project Delivery, Yyou will identify opportunities to maximise local value creation and positive social impact.

Your responsibilities will include:

Stakeholder Engagement & Consultation

• Design and deliver consultation activities and public participation processes throughout the project lifecycle.

• Act as the primary point of contact for local communities, interest groups and key stakeholders. Facilitating constructive dialogue and good neighbourship, creating understanding and trust between projects and local communities.

• Build trusted relationships and ensure stakeholder feedback is effectively integrated into project decision-making.

• Deliver meaningful stakeholder involvement that meets regulatory requirements and supports Vattenfall's ambition to go beyond compliance; identifying and supporting opportunities for local value creation.

Communications & Community Relations

• Ensure communities and stakeholders receive transparent, accurate and timely information throughout project development and delivery.

• Identify and support initiatives that enhance local value creation, community benefits and understanding of offshore wind.

Cross-functional Collaboration

• Represent Vattenfall at stakeholder forums, public events and consultation meetings, while supporting alignment across Hesselø, other Danish developments and the operational offshore wind portfolio.

• Contribute to supplier, local supply chain and landowner engagement activities where required.

• You will work in alignment and collaboration with the wider (Danish) Stakeholder Engagement team and their activities towards our development and operational portfolio.

Who are you?

You are an experienced stakeholder engagement professional who enjoys building relationships, creating trust and finding solutions in complex environments. With at least five years of relevant experience from major infrastructure, renewable energy or sustainable development projects, you understand that successful projects depend as much on people and communities as on technology and engineering. You have worked with external stakeholders such as communities, municipalities, NGOs, businesses and landowners, and you are confident developing engagement programmes, communication strategies and clear content for different audiences. You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and are comfortable navigating multiple interests, perspectives and priorities across development, permitting, construction or operational phases. As a natural relationship builder, you communicate clearly, listen attentively and remain calm and constructive in sensitive discussions. You are structured, proactive and collaborative, and motivated by the opportunity to contribute to the energy transition while creating positive outcomes for communities and society.

Next to this, you bring:

• A university degree in Communications, Community Development, Psychology, International Development, Political Science, Social Sciences or a related discipline.

• At least five years of experience in stakeholder engagement, community relations, communications or public consultation within major infrastructure, renewable energy or sustainable development projects.

• Strong understanding of stakeholder engagement across project development, permitting, construction or operational phases.

• Strong relationship-building, facilitation, influencing and conflict-resolution skills.

• Excellent Danish and English language skills, both written and spoken.

• Experience from offshore wind, renewable energy or major infrastructure projects is an advantage, particularly involving permitting or consenting processes or engagement with marine users, fisheries, environmental organisations, coastal communities, regulatory bodies or political stakeholders.

Location

Copenhagen or Kolding (DK). Frequent travel to project-relevant locations and occasional international travel required. You will be part of an international team.

Additional Information

Our offer

Looking for a career with growth?

Looking for a role where your superpowers can be leveraged to the maximum and with limitless opportunities for growth?

The scale and ambition of our wind, battery and solar business means you can really find your element with us. We’ll also provide you with all the learning and development you need to expand your horizons.

We strive to be the best place to work in the industry with highly competitive pay and conditions and an open, supportive culture. A commitment to a healthy work-life balance aims to ensure everyone plays to their strengths, whatever their background and experiences.

You will be part of a growing team of 1,700+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities where our positive approach to diversity is reflected in the fact that more than a quarter of staff are women.

More Information

For more information about the position or recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Christian Pathuel, christian.pathuel@vattenfall.com

We welcome your application in English no later than 28th of October 2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to building a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be a good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. Click here for further information.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

Since Vattenfall is a part of the Swedish critical infrastructure, many of our services are security classed. If this position is security classified the final candidates might be subject to a security vetting process, according to Swedish legislation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is an advanced systems and industrialization company developing integrated technology platforms for demanding aerospace, security, and mission-critical applications. Its mission is to transform operationally validated technologies into scalable, ready-to-deploy systems by combining advanced engineering, industrial partnerships, and strong governance.

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development. The site will build core capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, industrialization, and deployment of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be an advanced aerospace signal-intelligence product platform covering RF and system architecture, antenna-system design, RF and microwave hardware, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for qualification, production, and operational deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and international deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s mechanical design capability for antenna and RF systems. The role is intended for an experienced mechanical engineer with prior hands-on experience developing the mechanical implementation of antenna, RF, or microwave hardware.

You will design and develop mechanical solutions for antenna systems and associated RF and electronic assemblies. The work includes antenna supports and mounts, RF-aware enclosures, radomes, fixed and, where applicable, deployable antenna mechanisms, test fixtures, thermal solutions, connector integration, cable routing, sealing, environmental protection, and platform interfaces. Many of these structures can directly affect antenna and RF performance, requiring close co-design with antenna and RF engineers.

The role covers mechanical architecture, material and manufacturing-process selection, structural and thermal analysis, tolerance definition, detailed CAD design, prototyping, assembly, environmental validation, serviceability, and production release. Particular attention will be given to mechanical structures that directly affect antenna performance, integration, alignment, stability, and deployment.

You will work closely with antenna systems engineers, RF and microwave hardware engineers, system architects, RF test and characterization engineers, manufacturing partners, and partner engineering teams. The role requires strong mechanical design expertise, RF-aware product thinking, end-to-end technical ownership, and hands-on implementation experience, taking designs from concept through prototype build and qualification to documented, manufacturable antenna assemblies and integrated systems.

Key responsibilities

• Translate system, antenna, and platform requirements into mechanical architectures, interface definitions, design constraints, and technical trade-offs.

• Design mechanical components and assemblies for antenna systems, including supports, mounts, frames, radomes, RF-aware enclosures, fixed or deployable mechanisms, and platform-integration structures.

• Own the detailed mechanical implementation of antenna and RF assemblies, including 3D CAD models, 2D manufacturing drawings, GD&T, assembly-level tolerance analysis, BOMs, and configuration-controlled documentation.

• Develop mechanical solutions that maintain antenna alignment, dimensional stability, RF clearances, grounding, shielding, cable routing, connector accessibility, and other mechanical conditions required to achieve the intended electromagnetic performance.

• Integrate RF modules, antennas, electronics, connectors, cables, gaskets, thermal interfaces, and environmental sealing into complete mechanical assemblies.

• Perform structural, thermal, and tolerance analyses covering stiffness, strength, mass properties, thermal expansion, heat transfer, vibration, shock, and expected environmental loads.

• Define mechanical requirements and work jointly with antenna and RF engineers to establish electromagnetic constraints for radomes, covers, supports, enclosures, and other structures located within or near the antenna field.

• Design antenna deployment and positioning mechanisms, where applicable, including hinges, latches, restraints, stops, alignment features, and associated interfaces.

• Design test fixtures, alignment tools, handling aids, assembly tooling, and prototype-support hardware for antenna and RF system development.

• Select materials, coatings, surface treatments, fasteners, adhesives, seals, bearings, and manufacturing processes based on structural, thermal, RF, environmental, corrosion, and production requirements.

• Lead mechanical prototype build, assembly, troubleshooting, design verification, and iterative improvement.

• Contribute to environmental testing and qualification, including vibration, shock, thermal cycling, ingress protection, and other relevant mechanical validation activities.

• Apply design-for-manufacture, design-for-assembly, serviceability, reliability, and cost considerations throughout development.

• Work with suppliers and manufacturing partners on technical clarification, process selection, prototype production, inspection, non-conformance resolution, and production release.

• Prepare mechanical specifications, analysis reports, interface-control documentation, design-review materials, assembly instructions, and production handover documentation.

• Collaborate with antenna, RF and microwave hardware, system, test, electronics, manufacturing, and partner engineering teams.

• Help establish mechanical design standards, CAD practices, documentation templates, and engineering workflows for the Copenhagen design site.

Required qualifications and experience

• Degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

• 5+ years of professional mechanical design experience, including demonstrated experience developing mechanical hardware for antenna, RF, or microwave systems where mechanical geometry, materials, interfaces, tolerances, or nearby structures directly influence electromagnetic performance.

• Strong hands-on experience and demonstrated technical ownership of complex mechanical assemblies from initial architecture and concept through detailed design, prototype build, verification, qualification, and production release.

• Advanced proficiency with a professional 3D CAD and drafting environment; SolidWorks experience is preferred.

• Strong command of GD&T, engineering drawing standards, assembly-level tolerance analysis, and production-quality mechanical documentation.

• Demonstrated experience designing mechanical components or assemblies for antenna, RF, or microwave systems, such as antenna supports and mounts, frames, enclosures, radomes, mechanisms, fixtures, or other mechanically and electromagnetically constrained structures.

• Experience with mechanical packaging and integration of antennas, RF modules, PCBs, connectors, cables, thermal interfaces, shielding, grounding, seals, and associated electronics.

• Practical understanding of RF-aware mechanical design, including the effects of materials, structures, clearances, alignment, grounding, shielding, cabling, and radomes on antenna and RF performance.

• Experience applying engineering calculations and simulation methods, including finite-element analysis where appropriate, to support structural and thermal design decisions.

• Understanding of stiffness, strength, thermal expansion, heat transfer, vibration, shock, fatigue, and other relevant environmental loads.

• Practical knowledge of metallic materials, engineering polymers, elastomers, composites, adhesives, coatings, and surface treatments.

• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, such as precision machining, sheet-metal fabrication, additive manufacturing, composite manufacturing, joining, fastening, sealing, and assembly.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience with prototype assembly, mechanical troubleshooting, design verification, and iterative improvement.

• Experience supporting environmental testing and qualification, such as vibration, shock, thermal cycling, ingress protection, or comparable validation activities.

• Experience working with suppliers and manufacturing teams on process selection, technical clarification, inspection, non-conformance resolution, manufacturability, and production handover.

Nice to have

• Experience developing lightweight, stiffness-critical structures with stringent alignment and dimensional-stability requirements.

• Experience with aerospace or space-hardware qualification, including thermal-vacuum testing, outgassing constraints, vibration, and shock.

• Experience with precision mechanical alignment, dimensional inspection, antenna positioning, and calibration or verification fixtures.

• Experience designing IP-rated enclosures or ruggedized outdoor electronic equipment.

• Experience with product data management, configuration control, and release processes for complex mechanical assemblies.

• Experience working with international suppliers and manufacturing partners on low-volume, high-complexity hardware.

• Experience designing radomes, RF-transparent structures, or mechanical structures located within or near the antenna field.

• Experience with mechanically steerable, deployable, foldable, or position-critical antenna systems.

• Experience working directly with antenna or electromagnetic simulation engineers to iterate mechanical geometry, materials, and interfaces based on RF performance.

Success in the first 6 months

• Take end-to-end technical ownership of one or more mechanical subsystems or integration areas for antenna and RF systems.

• Establish the initial mechanical architecture, material and manufacturing approach, and platform-integration plan for the assigned scope.

• Deliver reviewed 3D models, manufacturing drawings, tolerance analyses, interface definitions, and supporting design documentation.

• Develop and support the build, assembly, and verification of initial mechanical prototypes, fixtures, or engineering models.

• Identify key structural, thermal, alignment, sealing, deployment, and manufacturability risks and define practical mitigation actions.

• Establish effective technical interfaces with antenna, RF and microwave hardware, system, test, electronics, manufacturing, supplier, and partner engineering teams.

• Help establish mechanical design standards, CAD practices, documentation templates, and release workflows for the Copenhagen design site.

**Job Description

****Are you passionate about developing and strengthening your database system skills, and like questioning the status quo for the benefit of Danske Bank and its customers?

**Then join our team and become our new Platform Database Engineer

We are looking for a profile who will be part of a global team responsible for building, configuring, and maintaining Danske Bank’s mainframe database systems. Our primary design goals are service availability, efficiency, and resilience, underpinned by the architectural principle of cloned infrastructure, system configurations and applications. The position is in Denmark, Copenhagen central or Århus.

**The role

**

• Perform database maintenance tasks, software upgrades coupled with administration and tuning to support our database environments and database tooling.

• Establish, maintain, and implement policies and procedures pertaining to database management, disaster recovery, security, maintenance, compliance, and utilization.

• Investigate new database functionality to explore and exploit new opportunities.

• Collect and analyze data to ensure optimal performance of the system.

• Be proactive in problem diagnostics and resolution and to challenge the existing where improvements could make sense.

• Encourage and ensure collaboration across teams and vendors to provide guidance and manage different tasks with a “can-do” attitude.

• Interact with vendors to troubleshoot and drive enhancements to product in our portfolio.

• Proactively help control risk and compliance and lead by example.

**Do you have what it takes?

**We need a new colleague, who takes ownership as an individual, but also one who teams up. You need to be curious about learning new technology, and we need a person who is not afraid of challenging status quo or taking personal initiative to help us drive superior solutions for the benefit of the Bank and its customers.

We would like to see the following core skills:

• Have some experience of installing, maintaining, and supporting database systems and related software products.

• Feel comfortable working with critical data on several platforms.

• Strong analytical mind and a determination to help drive/facilitate complex problems to resolution.

• Experience with design, configuration, and support of systems in an environment running mission critical 24*7*365 workload.

• Experience working with Public Cloud.

• Have an open mind and an inherent curiosity that can be a constant drive in your professional development.

**Additional Preferred Skills

**

• Degree related to Computer Science or IT

• Equivalent education with required experience

**What can we offer?

**We are a leading technology team with a global international and modern scene. We have global colleagues and workdays can easily be a flexible mix of physical and virtual presence. We will offer you many opportunities to grow your career and develop your competencies. We have inspirational leaders, who will support you to succeed, and we offer you great flexibility and autonomy.

**Interested?

**Does this sound like you? Then we look forward to hearing from you. We screen the applications on an ongoing basis, and we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. For questions, please contact Jesper Hollitsch Poulsen on JHP@danskebank.dk.

We need a new colleague, who takes ownership as an individual, but also one who teams up. You need to be curious about learning new technology, and we need a person who is not afraid of challenging status quo or taking personal initiative to help us drive superior solutions for the benefit of the Bank and its customers.

We would like to see the following core skills:

• Have some experience of installing, maintaining, and supporting database systems and related software products.

• Feel comfortable working with critical data on several platforms.

• Strong analytical mind and a determination to help drive/facilitate complex problems to resolution.

• Experience with design, configuration, and support of systems in an environment running mission critical 24*7*365 workload.

• Experience working with Public Cloud.

• Have an open mind and an inherent curiosity that can be a constant drive in your professional development.

Additional Preferred Skills

• Degree related to Computer Science or IT

• Equivalent education with required experience

What can we offer?

We are a leading technology team with a global international and modern scene. We have global colleagues and workdays can easily be a flexible mix of physical and virtual presence. We will offer you many opportunities to grow your career and develop your competencies. We have inspirational leaders, who will support you to succeed, and we offer you great flexibility and autonomy.

Interested?

Does this sound like you? Then we look forward to hearing from you. We screen the applications on an ongoing basis, and we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. For questions, please contact Jesper Hollitsch Poulsen on JHP@danskebank.dk.

Kassow Robots is a Danish company that develops and manufactures unique 7-axis collaborative robots for a wide range of industrial applications. Since 2022, we have been part of Bosch Rexroth, a leading global automation company within the Bosch Group.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology and hands-on problem solving? In our Assembly and Repair Department, you will take on an important role, working with colleagues to assemble, repair, and improve complete robot systems.

At our young technology company, you will join a diverse and dedicated team of passionate colleagues who make a real difference every day. You’ll experience a dynamic work environment where collaboration, innovation, and quality are at the heart of everything we do.

Your Primary Responsibilities

• Inspect, analyze, and troubleshoot robotic systems and equipment

• Read repair manuals and collaborate with engineers and other specialists

• Run tests, interpret results, and provide effective recommendations

• Write reports, safety regulations, and preventative maintenance plans

• Source and replace faulty parts and components

• Perform both mechanical and electrical assembly of robot systems

• Support manufacturing and development engineers in ongoing projects

• Handle service requests via our support system

• Stay up to date with advancements in the field and attend workshops as needed

What We’re Looking For

• Practical experience with installation, repair, and troubleshooting of complex systems, ideally including electronics and cabling

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to learn quickly

• A quality-conscious, systematic, and hands-on approach to work

• Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and thrive in a dynamic environment

• Excellent team player with strong communication skills

• A customer-oriented mindset with a focus on delivering reliable solutions

What We Offer

• Comprehensive training in our robot systems and installations

• A collaborative and innovative work environment in a growing tech company

• Opportunity to work with state-of-the-art robotics

• Personal and professional development through workshops and knowledge sharing

• A role where your contributions directly impact the company’s success

📍 Workplace: All work takes place at our company headquarters in Kastrup.

Shape the future of education technology

At IST, we're building the cloud platform that powers educational solutions used by more than five million users across Europe. Unlike most cloud teams, we run our own cloud — on our own hardware, in our own data center. That means the abstraction stops with us: when a node misbehaves, there's no support ticket to a hyperscaler.

There's a rack, and someone who knows it.

We're looking for a Cloud Engineer who finds that appealing rather than daunting.

About the role

As a Cloud Engineer, you'll help design, build and operate the IST Cloud Platform — from the automation and orchestration layers our developers build on, all the way down to the switches, servers and cabling that carry it. You'll do this together with our Cloud Engineering team, architects, developers and stakeholders, whether the work happens at a keyboard or in a rack.

In practice, around a quarter of your time will be spent physically on site in the data center. Not as a separate duty, but as a natural part of the work: expanding capacity for a new cluster the team has just automated, replacing a switch that's been throwing errors in your own monitoring, tracing a network issue that turns out to be a cable rather than a config. Owning the platform end to end is what makes this role different from a pure cloud position.

The role is based at our office in Roskilde, Denmark, with the primary data center within reach. Some travel is required, primarily to our office in Växjö, Sweden.

Key responsibilities

• Design, build and operate the IST Cloud Platform across the full stack — from physical hardware to the self-service tooling our developers use

• Automate VMs, containers, storage and networking using Ansible, Terraform, Puppet and PowerShell DSC

• Plan and carry out capacity expansions: from sizing and procurement to racking, cabling, provisioning and putting the capacity into production

• Diagnose and resolve issues wherever they originate — including replacing switches, disks and other failed components on site, and handling firmware, BIOS and driver lifecycle across the fleet

• Support reliable, scalable developer platforms, CI/CD pipelines, orchestration and self-service tools

• Manage databases, object storage and monitoring/logging stacks, with observability that spans both the platform and the hardware underneath it

• Contribute to access, identity and compliance work in line with ISO, PCI and internal policies, including physical access and site security

• Ensure robust backup and disaster recovery plans are in place, tested against real hardware failure scenarios

• Coordinate with hardware vendors and support partners (Dell, Cisco and similar) on spare parts, RMAs and escalations

Your profile

You have a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, network engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, along with solid experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure automation and DevOps practices.

Just as importantly, you're comfortable at both ends of the stack. You can discuss platform architecture with our developers in the morning and spend the afternoon in the rack with a screwdriver, and you see those as the same job rather than two different ones. Working in a data center environment — noisy, cold, occasionally at short notice — is something you take in stride.

We also look for:

• Hands-on experience with server, storage and network hardware — Cisco, Dell, KVM, VMware or similar

• Practical understanding of data center fundamentals: power, cooling, rack design, structured cabling

• Strong knowledge of security, compliance and governance in cloud environments

• Strategic thinking and the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

• A collaborative, decisive and pragmatic approach to problem-solving

• A valid driver's license and the ability to reach the data center when needed

What we offer

This is a full-time, permanent position. We apply an office-first policy, and given the hands-on nature of this role, regular physical presence at the office and in the datacenter is part of the job. Within that framework, there's room for flexibility on the days where your work doesn't require you on site.

You'll join an international and collaborative environment where you'll have real ownership, influence over strategic technology decisions, and the chance to help shape the future of learning.

Apply

Applications are reviewed continuously. For questions, contact Bengt Welin bengt.welin@ist.com or HR@ist.com. Please note that a background check is part of the recruitment process.

Welcome to apply!

jobs.occupation: Special Consultant for HealthTech Innovation and Venture Development – DTU Entrepreneurship
jobs.description:
DTU is strengthening its collaboration with Rigshospitalet in the Technical University Hospital (TUH). We aim to create a coherent innovation pathway from identification of unmet clinical needs through exploration, prototyping and validation to startup formation and commercialisation.

DTU Entrepreneurship is looking for an experienced Special Consultant to coordinate and further develop this HealthTech innovation pipeline.

You will work at the intersection of technology, healthcare, education, entrepreneurship and commercialisation. A central part of the role will be to connect existing DTU and hospital activities into a functioning pathway. We will ensure that promising HealthTech opportunities can progress between educational programmes, clinical environments, prototyping activities and venture development.

You will collaborate closely with DTU Entrepreneurship, TUH, Rigshospitalet, DTU Skylab and TUH Skylab, relevant DTU departments, clinicians, course responsibles, students and external ecosystem partners.

The job
You will coordinate DTU Entrepreneurship's contribution to the TUH HealthTech innovation initiative. Further contribute hands-on to the development and maturation of selected HealthTech opportunities.

Your primary tasks will include:

• Coordinating the HealthTech innovation initiative across DTU, hospitals and other key stakeholders.
• Developing and maintaining a HealthTech innovation pipeline from clinical need identification to venture creation.
• Supporting the identification and prioritisation of unmet clinical needs in collaboration with clinicians and other experts.
• Providing business development and commercialisation support to selected HealthTech projects, including market assessment, business models, partnerships and funding.
• Mentoring multidisciplinary student teams and potential founders through teaching, coaching and venture development activities.
• Engaging relevant external stakeholders and contributing to the continued development of DTU's HealthTech innovation ecosystem.
You will have a high degree of independence in planning and executing activities while working closely with the TUH leadership and key stakeholders.

We are looking for a senior profile with strong experience in HealthTech innovation, entrepreneurship and commercialisation.

We expect that you have:

• An MSc degree in engineering, technology or a related scientific discipline.
• Proven experience in developing and commercialising healthcare technologies from early-stage innovation to venture creation or market implementation.
• Experience working across the healthcare, university and startup ecosystems.
• Strong business development and commercialisation skills, including market assessment, business model development and stakeholder engagement.
• Experience leading complex projects involving multiple stakeholders.
• Excellent communication, collaboration and facilitation skills.
• Professional proficiency in Danish and English.
It will be an advantage if you have:

• Founder or senior leadership experience from a MedTech or life-science company.
• A PhD or additional education in business, innovation or entrepreneurship.
• Experience with fundraising, partnerships or innovation funding programmes.
What we offer in return
You will become part of DTU Entrepreneurship and work closely with colleagues across DTU and the Technical University Hospital collaboration.

The position offers an opportunity to play a central role in developing a new university-hospital HealthTech innovation pipeline. This means to work with projects spanning clinical unmet needs, engineering, entrepreneurship, prototyping and venture creation.

You will interact with a broad ecosystem of clinicians, researchers, students, entrepreneurs, industry representatives, investors and innovation organisations. You will contribute to establishing a capability intended to remain beyond the present project period.

The role combines strategic development with hands-on engagement in individual innovation and venture projects.

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). You are employed as an Senior Officer or Senior Executive Officer. In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. 

The position is a fixed-term, part-time Special Consultant position until 31 December 2028. The expected employment is 29,6 hours per week. The starting date is 1 November 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Because the activities vary over the project period, the position requires flexibility in the organisation of working time. There will be periods of increased activity around project milestones, educational activities, stakeholder engagement and international collaboration.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than Tuesday, 27 October 2026. Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Professor Thomas Howard on thow@dtu.dk.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Entrepreneurship is amongst the leading international entities in technology entrepreneurship and helps develop an entrepreneurial culture across DTU. As part of a dynamic and evolving ecosystem, we combine practice-oriented education and research in entrepreneurship with real start-up opportunities from all DTU departments. With rigorous research at its core, the Center builds the entrepreneurial capabilities of students, industry leaders, academics and policymakers to address unsolved problems, and together create new knowledge, methodologies and initiatives. We enable ethically minded entrepreneurs to build solutions that benefit people, society and the world. The Center experiments with new entrepreneurial methodologies and activities to push boundaries within research and education.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.
